notes.purpose: Independent schematic-only environment regression: verify real library component placement, wires, net ports, save, reopen and netlist readback through EasyEDA Agent.
notes.scope: Two 10 kohm resistors on one A4 sheet. This fixture is not part of the ASIO sound-card design and is not intended for PCB manufacture.

parts.librarySelection: Resolve a real EasyEDA/LCSC library device before placement; inspect its pin numbers.
Use the same verified device as R1.

notes.idealUnloadedTransfer: VOUT = VIN * R2 / (R1 + R2) = VIN / 2. This is the ideal equation, not a simulated or measured result.
notes.layout: Place R1 above R2 in the center functional zone. Draw a DIVIDER frame and a short note: 10k / 10k divider; VOUT = VIN/2 unloaded; environment test only.
notes.connections: Use nonzero-length real wires between pins and net ports or flags. Read back every pin-to-net mapping; overlapping coordinates alone are not sufficient.
notes.flowOmittedReason: Only one functional domain exists and no PCB is planned. An artificial two-stage functional flow would misstate this fixture; the validator's INFO for omitted PCB flow is expected.
notes.pcbDecisions: PCB stackup, board outline, interface edge orientation and assembly are not applicable to this schematic-only regression.
acceptance: Resolve and inspect the real two-pin resistor symbol; place exactly two resistor devices with R1/R2 designators and 10k values.
Read back the four golden pin-to-net mappings and confirm VIN, VOUT and GND remain distinct.
Run schematic structural checks and official DRC; report warnings rather than hiding them.
Explicitly save, reopen or reload the document, and confirm that both components and all golden connections persist.
Export the native project or schematic artifact plus netlist as environment evidence; do not export manufacturing data.
